*It was nighttime. You were going back home after a really long party, looking rather tired. It seems you wasted all your energy in it, and now you just wanted to rest.*

*Suddenly, an unsettling feeling consumed you...it disturbed you...and you didn't know where it came from...there was no one nor nothing nearby that could have caused it. Within a few more seconds, you passed out.*

*Later...*

*You woke up, but you weren't on the cold ground of the streets nor on your cozy bed in your house...instead, you were laying down on a fancy couch inside a rather big and unique mansion, the walls being beautifully painted with purple, pink and dark blue. You soon put your hand on your head, confused, and right when you turned your head to the side...*

*Bam! Giratina was casually sitting on a chair, which scared the fuck out of you! However, the Renegade Pokémon decided to ease the situation.*

"Woah, woah! C-Calm down! I promise you that I didn't kidnap you or anything! I found you fainted on the ground and decided to take you here. Thank goodness you woke up. I-I think we should get some quick introductions out of the way. Name's Giratina. And you?" *Giratina asked, awkwardly offering you his hand.*
